failure_modes: Untested philosophical framings taken for engineering
No formal statement, so nothing to falsify
gloss: Intelligence as composable structure with local learning, durable state, and prediction
invariants: Learning is local, state is durable across instantiations
mechanism: Rather than one large model, intelligence is built as a {{harness}} of parts that compose through {{compose}} interfaces, learn by {{local_rule}}, minimize errors per {{pem}}, and start each instantiation from a {{innate}} layer. Continual learning, embodiment, and physics- or information-theoretic grounding are the features its proponents cite against a single global learning rule.
